items.source: There are two ways that this can be set: before initializing the session (either with the session-keyspace option in the configuration, or with SessionBuilder.withKeyspace(CqlIdentifier)); or at runtime, if the client issues a request that changes the keyspace (such as a CQL USE query). Note that this second method is inherently unsafe, since other requests expecting the old keyspace might be executing concurrently. Therefore it is highly discouraged, aside from trivial cases (such as a cqlsh-style program where requests are never concurrent).
items.translation: 有两种方式可以设置此选项：在初始化会话之前（通过配置中的 session-keyspace 选项，或使用 SessionBuilder.withKeyspace(CqlIdentifier)）；或者在运行时，如果客户端发出更改键空间的请求（例如 CQL USE 查询）。请注意，第二种方法本质上是不安全的，因为其他期望旧键空间的请求可能正在并发执行。因此，除了微不足道的情况（例如类似 cqlsh 的程序，其中请求永远不会并发）外，强烈不建议使用这种方法。

items.source: Note that this method returns true as soon as the closing of this Session has started but it does not guarantee that the closing is done. If you want to guarantee that the closing is done, you can call close() and wait until it returns (or call the get method on closeAsync() with a very short timeout and check this doesn't timeout).
items.translation: 请注意，此方法在会话关闭开始时即返回 true，但并不保证关闭操作已完成。如果您希望确保关闭操作确实完成，可以调用close()并等待其返回（或调用closeAsync()的 get 方法并设置一个极短的超时时间，然后检查是否发生超时）。

items.source: In order to provide atomic updates, this method returns an immutable object: the node list, token map, and schema contained in a given instance will always be consistent with each other (but note that Node itself is not immutable: some of its properties will be updated dynamically, in particular Node.getState()).
items.translation: 为了提供原子更新，此方法返回一个不可变对象：给定实例中包含的节点列表、令牌映射和模式将始终彼此一致（但请注意，Node 本身并非不可变：其某些属性将动态更新，特别是 Node.getState()）。

items.source: Please note that if the same CQL statement is prepared more than once, all calls to this method will return the same PreparedStatement object but the method will still apply the properties of the prepared Statement to this object.
items.translation: 请注意，如果同一个 CQL 语句被多次准备，对该方法的所有调用都将返回相同的 PreparedStatement 对象，但该方法仍会将已准备的 Statement 的属性应用到该对象上。

items.source:
This method blocks until at least some result has been received from the database. However, for SELECT queries, it
does not guarantee that the result has been received in full. But it does guarantee that some response has been
received from the database, and in particular guarantees that if the request is invalid, an exception will be
thrown by this method.
items.translation: 该方法会阻塞，直到从数据库收到至少部分结果。然而，对于 SELECT 查询，它并不保证已完整接收所有结果。但它确实保证已从数据库收到某种响应，特别是如果请求无效，此方法将抛出异常。
